### 🎯 Feature Proposal Summary

### 🚀 Proposed Solution & User Experience

- How should the feature work?
- Where should the controls or options appear in the UI (SIR Launcher, R-Shift HUD, Web Hub)?
- How does this benefit the player community?

Which layer(s) of the ecosystem does this proposal touch?
- [ ] Desktop Launcher Pro (`SIR Launcher.exe`)

- [ ] Dedicated Server Orchestrator (`SIR Server Manager.exe`)
- [ ] Modern 26.2 Engine (Fabric 0.19.4 / ASM Bytecode remapper)
- [ ] Legacy 1.8.9 Engine (Forge PvP / 0ms RawInput)

- [ ] Resource Packs (Patrix 3D POM / Ocean Physics / 32x PvP)
- [ ] In-Game R-Shift HUD Studio / Lunar Client synergy

### 🌟 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or links about the feature request here.
